title: OpenRC aircraft data v1
description: Structural and per-field validation for aircraft_data.gd v1 inputs. Physics and cross-field consistency remain runtime checks.
$comment: The loader remains authoritative for coupled physical checks, ordered table samples, geometric support, and integrated areas. Quantity sources and landing-gear contact names mirror Godot String.strip_edges: ASCII U+0001–U+0020 alone is blank, while Unicode spaces remain content; JSON parsing replaces NUL with U+FFFD.
